name: Mateo Velez
bio:
Mateo's journey into motorsport started unconventionally, not on the track, but in the bustling workshops of Medellin, Colombia. He initially pursued a mechanical engineering degree, but a local Formula SAE project ignited his passion for aerodynamics. He honed his skills through relentless experimentation and data analysis, quickly becoming the go-to guy for optimizing vehicle performance. He's worked with smaller teams in Formula Regional and Formula 3, and he’s built a reputation as a problem-solver who can squeeze performance out of limited resources.

Mateo's approach to aerodynamics is rooted in practical application. He values data-driven decision-making and believes in a collaborative environment where engineers, drivers, and mechanics work in sync. He understands that even the most sophisticated simulations are useless without real-world validation. Mateo is known for his ability to distill complex aerodynamic principles into easily understandable concepts for the entire team, fostering a shared understanding and maximizing efficiency. He's looking for a team where he can bring his experience and lead the aero department to a new level.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed back with a slight wave
physical.description: Mateo is of medium height and has a focused, intense gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with aerodynamic calculations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
Insists on having a clear, unobstructed view of the wind tunnel data during testing.
